title: Ingest event (adapter -> backend)
description: One normalised sensor record. POST /api/ingest/events takes {"events": [ ... ]}, max 100 per request. Backend adds event_id and ingested_at. Version 1.1 is additive: every valid 1.0 event is still valid. See contracts/API.md 'Evidence boundaries (v1.1)'.

source_record_id.description: Stable per sensor record. Cowrie: sha256 of the raw JSON line. Web: request uuid. Dedup key is (ingest namespace, sensor_id, source_record_id); the namespace is 'live' for live events and 'replay:<lab_run_id>' for replay events.

origin_record_id.description: v1.1. Replay only: source_record_id of the original captured record this replay copies. Null or absent for live events.

event_type.description: bait_served is v1.1: the sensor returned content containing one or more honeytokens.

session_id.description: Sensor session id. Cowrie: its session id. Web: the decoy's session cookie id once it issues one, else null (backend then groups by a documented 5-minute inactivity bucket).

lab_run_id.description: Set once per run. A run has exactly one capture_mode: the first accepted event fixes it, and events with the other mode for that run are rejected. Use a 'replay-' prefix for replay runs by convention.

client_version.description: Client-claimed banner. A claim, not identity.

query_redacted.description: Query string with any honeytoken or password values replaced by <redacted>

honeytoken_id.description: A honeytoken PRESENTED by the client (login, query). For served bait use honeytoken_ids.

asset_id.description: Synthetic object id. v1.1 bait assets: 'ssh:/home/dg_demo/notes.txt', 'web:/.env'.

sha256.description: Digest of the full served content (see digest_scope).

outcome.description: 1.0 values served/denied/not_found keep their meaning. v1.1 adds attempted, emulated_success, failed, unknown. 'served' equals emulated_success for a synthetic file.

observation_kind.description: v1.1. What the record observed: client input on the wire, a shell command, the decoy's emulated result, or a policy decision. If absent the backend derives it from event_type (API.md).

evidence_role.description: v1.1. Shorthand used by findings and links: request = client input, result = the decoy's answer or policy outcome, bait = content carrying a honeytoken was served.

request_id.description: v1.1, web. One id per HTTP request; every record about that request carries it.

honeytoken_ids.description: v1.1, bait_served only. Tokens contained in the served content. Ids only, never values.

issuance_id.description: v1.1, bait_served. Unique per serving (or per per-session token if the decoy mints them).

issued_expires_at.description: v1.1, bait_served. Optional expiry; null = valid until the run ends.

evidence_basis.description: v1.1, bait_served. sensor_response = the decoy itself recorded sending the content. derived_from_command = the adapter inferred it from a read command on a known bait path in the emulated filesystem (weaker; shown as such).

derived_from_record_id.description: v1.1, required when evidence_basis = derived_from_command: source_record_id of the command record it was derived from.

fixture_version.description: v1.1. Version of the synthetic asset or bait file.
